h15.text: Cardinal Commitment – Provides a free-tuition guarantee to new students with a family AGI at or below $70,000 (eligibility criteria was recently expanded). Saginaw Valley Opportunity Grant (SVSU’s primary need-based grant) expanded to undergraduate transfer students, in addition to first-time students. Automatic merit scholarships based on high school GPA were increased. The Red & White Scholarship for out-of-state and international students was increased to bring tuition costs down to in-state levels ($10,320 scholarship annually).
